Symptom: Blue delegation warning on the browse gallery; only the first 500 Booking Request rows are searchable
Evidence: Power Apps Studio flags Filter('Booking Requests', Len('Pet Name') > 3); App Checker lists it under Delegation; the gallery stops at 500 rows
RootCause: Len() is not delegable to Dataverse, so the filter runs client-side over the first page only
Fix: Rewrote the filter as Filter('Booking Requests', StartsWith('Pet Name', txtSearch.Text)) - StartsWith is delegable; warning cleared and all rows searched

Symptom: Booking Approval flow shows a Failed run; the Update a row action returns 400 Bad Request
Evidence: Run history > Update a row > Inputs shows Row ID empty; the Outputs pane returns 'A required property is missing'
RootCause: The dynamic-content reference to the trigger's Booking Request row id was dropped when the Condition was re-ordered
Fix: Re-inserted the trigger's Booking Request unique identifier into the Row ID field with the dynamic-content picker, saved, then Resubmit on the failed run

Symptom: The shared user opens the app and sees an empty gallery plus 'You do not have permission to read records of type Booking Request'
Evidence: Browser console shows an HTTP 403 from the Dataverse Web API; the maker's own account loads the same screen with data
RootCause: The app was shared at Can use but no Dataverse security role granting Read on Booking Request was assigned to that user
Fix: Assigned the Kennel Supervisor security role in the Power Platform admin centre > Environment > Settings > Users; the gallery populated after a browser refresh

Symptom: In the Test environment the imported solution shows the Booking Approval flow turned off and marked 'Connection not configured'
Evidence: Solutions > Contoso Real Estate > Objects > Connection references shows the Dataverse reference with no connection selected
RootCause: Managed solutions carry the connection reference but not the connection; the Test environment had no Dataverse connection bound to it
Fix: Created a Dataverse connection in Test, edited the connection reference to point at it, then turned the flow on and ran a smoke test
